"""Reproduce: FieldError when migrating a field to a new model subclass.

Usage: python repro.py <phase>   phase in {setup, change, makemig, migrate}
"""
import os
import sys

import django
from django.conf import settings
from django.core.management import call_command

BASE = "C:/Windows/Temp/repro"
APP_DIR = os.path.join(BASE, "app")
sys.path.insert(0, BASE)

PHASE = sys.argv[1]

settings.configure(
    DEBUG=True,
    DATABASES={"default": {"ENGINE": "django.db.backends.sqlite3", "NAME": os.path.join(BASE, "db.sqlite3")}},
    INSTALLED_APPS=["django.contrib.contenttypes", "django.contrib.auth", "app"],
    USE_TZ=True,
    MIGRATION_MODULES={"app": "app.migrations"},
)
django.setup()

MODELS_PHASE1 = """from django.db import models

class Readable(models.Model):
    title = models.CharField(max_length=200)
"""

MODELS_PHASE2 = """from django.db import models

class Readable(models.Model):
    pass

class Book(Readable):
    title = models.CharField(max_length=200)
"""

if PHASE == "setup":
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(APP_DIR, "migrations"), exist_ok=True)
    for p in [os.path.join(APP_DIR, "__init__.py"), os.path.join(APP_DIR, "migrations", "__init__.py")]:
        open(p, "w").close()
    open(os.path.join(APP_DIR, "apps.py"), "w").write(
        "from django.apps import AppConfig\n"
        "class AppConfig(AppConfig):\n    name = 'app'\n"
    )
    open(os.path.join(APP_DIR, "models.py"), "w").write(MODELS_PHASE1)
    call_command("makemigrations", "app", verbosity=2)
    call_command("migrate", verbosity=2)
    print("SETUP OK")
elif PHASE == "change":
    open(os.path.join(APP_DIR, "models.py"), "w").write(MODELS_PHASE2)
    print("CHANGED")
elif PHASE == "makemig":
    call_command("makemigrations", "app", verbosity=3)
    print("MAKEMIGRATIONS OK")
elif PHASE == "migrate":
    call_command("migrate", verbosity=3)
    print("MIGRATE OK")
